notes.note: Ambiguous; tested the permissive reading: getcall, reply and raise are applied on a port whose in list contains the signature. The exclusive reading (only these operations) is not tested.

Ambiguous; tested as a static consistency check: the system port type has in lists matching a component port using receive/trigger/getcall/reply/raise. noexecution because receiving from the SUT is required.
Ambiguous; tested as a static consistency check: the system port type has out lists matching a component port using send/call/getreply/catch. noexecution because an SUT response is required.
Uses distinct component and system port types, both declaring integer as out, and sends via the mapped port; it does not check that a tool rejects the opposite (TSI-view) direction.
Port type with only an address declaration (allowed by the BNF but without any in/out/inout list). Titan does not check this rule and accepts it.

Uses a component type as message type; component types are not data types (they hold object references). Titan accepts component references as messages as a tool extension, so its acceptance is not authoritative.
